## Summary

What will someone using Thumbly notice?

## How to test

- [ ] `node scripts/build.mjs --check` passes
- [ ] `node scripts/check.mjs` passes
- [ ] Tried the change in a browser (`src/index.html`, the rebuilt `index.html`, or both)

## Checklist

- [ ] If `src/` changed, `index.html` was rebuilt and committed
- [ ] Docs stay accurate if the behavior changed
